calculation.description: Within-day cross-sectional relative five-day shocks are reversed, scaled by each asset's 30-day volatility, and activated only during elevated cross-sectional dispersion. The complete signal is lagged one trading day.

validation.regime_notes: 2026-2028 IC 0.007587/ICIR 0.028174 over 322 dates; 2029-2030 IC 0.039282/ICIR 0.155854 over 249 dates; 2031-2032-01-07 IC 0.060401/ICIR 0.258962 over 131 dates. Early 2020-2025 excluded because the dispersion activation requires sufficient 120-day history and the available synthetic aligned panel begins later for this artifact. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
